publicSources.scope: Official source discovery only; not KLIKS authorization or provider access.

requirements.requirement: Identified legal entity, jurisdiction and qualified case-specific review of the proposed no-custody operating model.
Applicable regulatory route and any required authorization, registration, approvals or partner coverage established by competent sources.
Identified authorized institution/provider with agreed KLIKS/partner duties, permitted customer and merchant scope, and commercial/operational conditions.
Authentic versioned API and sandbox documentation covering the actual proposed account-to-account flow and institution coverage.
Explicitly authorized synthetic-data sandbox access and test-account route, with secrets handled outside source control and model prompts.
Documented customer/provider authentication, bank authorization, consent, expiry/revocation, delegation and recovery responsibilities.
Reviewed alias-directory legality, data roles/basis, disclosure, retention/deletion, number recycling and transfer/residency requirements.
Authoritative initiation/status/finality semantics, institution and rail coverage, reconciliation data and permitted user-facing timing claims.
Documented idempotency, timeouts, safe retry/status recovery, duplicate and out-of-order notification handling and error ownership.
Agreed cancellation, recall, rejection, return/refund, dispute, complaint, liability and support escalation semantics.
Reviewed provider onboarding/security requirements and a sandbox isolation/secret-management plan, with production hardening obligations explicitly tracked.
Named human review of all prerequisite evidence, a scoped gate decision, explicit Phase 12 approval and a reviewed superseding mock-only architecture decision.
